description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - board capture: aim at a blackboard or whiteboard, take a telephoto photo, and READ sends the photo to the host language model as a data: URL image (the official read-text path - there is no OCR), returning a labelled transcription plus one-line summary you verify before KEEP files it; dictate your own summary line as fallback, and SPEAK plays the whole outline in capture order. Photos are never saved - only text is kept, on device
name: board-capture
